utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word and keep folks in the loop. Once we’ve got the hall drop-off time set, I’ll help pull everything together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still happening then, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the neighborhood repair drive next weekend — I’m still a bit behind, but I can help with setup or carrying stuff. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can keep track of the supplies quietly and share only what’s needed. Thanks for being considerate about my privacy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. Just let me know what’s still missing for the neighborhood repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: The one we’ve been planning together — I’m heading to the community hall now so we can sort out the timing and check what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s lock in the community hall drop-off time first, and then I can firm up the repair drive timing. What works for you, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the community hall drop-off time works for me. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can do either—want me to spread the word or check what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Jules — could you check what we still need for the repair drive? I can handle spreading the word and bring the tools by soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping track of the repair drive locations—do you want the drop-off spot or the next place on the list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The drop-off spot, please—where should people bring the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — we’re just nailing down the time, place, and supplies. I’ll keep everyone posted as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — just let me know when and where, and I can help with setup or hauling supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — let’s lock in the hall drop-off time first, and then I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — let’s keep it simple: please list the repair-drive jobs, and we’ll meet Saturday at 10 a.m. to go over it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works — I’ll keep the list simple and have it ready for Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on for Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping everything organized. If you need, I can share your part or the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—please share my part and the drop-off details. I’ll help with setup and carrying items.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can keep track of supplies. What do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks — I still need a drill if you’ve got one, and maybe a quick count of any extra supplies so we can keep things moving.
